fr_html: M. LODER remercie Lord Phillimore de ses explications. Il croit cependant devoir maintenir son opposition contre l'article qui, dans son opinion, crée une Cour qui n'en est pas une, en instituant des juges qui n'ont pas le caractère de véritables juges.
en_html: M. LODER thanked Lord Phillimore for his explanations. He felt, however, that he must continue to oppose the Article, as, in his opinion, it would establish a Court that was not a true Court, since it would create judges not possessing the characteristics of true judges.
